description: Defines the Message interface for handling messages between Things or Features in the Eclipse Ditto project, including message headers, payloads, direction, and metadata.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Interface representing a message to or from a Thing or Feature, with methods to access headers, payload, direction, and metadata.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for constructing an immutable Message, given message headers.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers of the message, including client-specific and user-defined headers.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the message payload as an Optional, may be empty if no payload is provided.

methods.name: getRawPayload
methods.description: Returns the raw payload as ByteBuffer, may be empty if no raw payload is provided.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns additional data included via signal enrichment.

methods.name: getResponseConsumer
methods.description: Returns the MessageResponseConsumer associated with the message (deprecated).

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the message (FROM or TO a Thing or Feature).

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the Thing ID as String; use getThingEntityId() instead.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with the message.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the message.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID if applicable.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the payload.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for the message.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the message.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID of the message.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context associated with the message.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the message.
